# Basics of Bayesian inference

This lab will guide you through an introduction to using *brms* for Bayesian model inference. You can download the template `.qmd` file for this lab here:

{{< downloadthis labs/lab10-bayes-basics.qmd dname=lab10-bayes-basics label="Download lab template">}}

The template will prompt you to work through the following sections.



```{r}
#| include: false

library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(brms)
library(bayesplot)


source("R/utils.R")
out <- render_lab("labs/lab10-bayes-basics.qmd")
```
